title: BRAND_RULES
description: Operational brand rules in a form a machine can check. BRAND_RULES.md stays the human read; this is the same rules expressed so a piece can be tested against them before it ships.

kind.description: forbid: the piece must not match. require: the piece must match.

statement.description: The rule as a person would state it.

scope.description: Where the rule applies. Defaults to all.

severity.description: block fails the check; warn reports without failing. Defaults to block.

evidence_refs.description: Evidence in BRAND_EVIDENCE that this rule was derived from, not invented.

type.description: regex: checkable automatically. manual: needs human or agent judgement, and is reported as unverified rather than silently passed.

asks.description: For manual rules: the question a reviewer has to answer.
